models.name: Avocado
models.description: The smiling 23-piece avocado from LEGO Classic 11039 Creative Food Friends, with lime flesh, a round brown stone and squeezed-shut eyes.

models.name: Bat
models.description: A tiny bat in 22 pieces, 8 cm across its wings: angry yellow eyes, two white fangs, pointed ears and little clip feet.

models.name: Birthday Cake
models.description: The 20-piece birthday cake from LEGO Classic 11039: white frosting, sleepy eyes, a cherry and a candle.

models.name: Caldwell County Courthouse Mini
models.description: A small, quick kids' build of the 1894 courthouse in Lockhart, Texas: buff stone walls with a red band, slate roofs on the four corner pavilions, and the clock tower with a clock on each side under a steep slate spire and a red finial. It comes with the clockmaster, a minifigure in a top hat. The big display version is The Caldwell County Courthouse.

models.name: Charmander
models.description: A tiny Charmander in 14 pieces, about 4 cm long and 3 cm tall: an orange body on two round feet, a tan belly, a curved dome of a head with a black eye band, and a trans-orange flame on the end of its tail.

models.name: Crow
models.description: A little black crow in 34 pieces, 7 cm from beak to tail: a pointed beak, half-closed eyes, two wings and two tail feathers on clips, and yellow feet. Designed by Qrys.And.Reading.

models.name: Mini T. rex
models.description: A tiny red-and-orange dinosaur with an open toothy mouth, black eyes, clip-on red arms, dark-tan feet, downward-curving white claws, and a tapering tail. Reconstructed from a single reference image.

models.name: Dracula
models.description: A tiny Dracula in 32 pieces, about 4.5 cm tall: big round eyes, grey skin, two white fangs over a red mouth, slicked-back black hair with a widow's peak, and his shoes poking out under the cape.

models.name: Finn the Human
models.description: Finn the Human from Adventure Time as a lanky, posable figure in 121 pieces, 19.4 cm tall: a white hat with two round ears, a wide grin, noodle arms and legs, a round green backpack and his golden sword.

models.name: Frankenstein
models.description: A tiny Frankenstein in 17 pieces, about 4.5 cm tall: a flat-topped grey head with sleepy white eyes, a grey brow bar and two white neck bolts, on a black body and base.

models.name: Freddy Fazbear
models.description: A tiny Freddy Fazbear in 42 pieces, about 9 cm tall: a brown bear robot with a top hat, a black bow tie, big round eyes and a light snout, holding a microphone.

models.name: Magikarp
models.description: A Magikarp in 43 pieces, 6.5 cm long and 6.4 cm high: a red fish built sideways off two brackets, with round white eyes, an open lavender mouth, a white forked tail and a yellow fin on its back and under its belly.

models.name: Surprised Pikachu
models.description: The surprised Pikachu face in 50 pieces, 9 cm across the ears and 6 cm tall: wide eyes, red cheeks, a small black nose over an open pink mouth, and pointed black-tipped ears that swing on clips.
models.credit: Another builder's design: its plans do not name them. If it is yours, tell us and we will credit you.

models.name: Porygon
models.description: A tiny Porygon in 19 pieces, about 3 cm long and 3 cm tall: a pink head and body, a blue beak, chest, feet and tail, and a round eye on each side of its head.

models.name: Pumpkin
models.description: A jack-o'-lantern pumpkin in 51 pieces, about 5.4 cm across and 6.8 cm tall with its leaf: a cube of plates built on its sides, with square black eyes, a toothy mouth and a green stem with a leaf (a design by BrixBuild).

models.name: Taco
models.description: The 23-piece taco from LEGO Classic 11039 Creative Food Friends: a happy yellow shell around tomato, green and brown fillings and four lettuce leaves.

models.name: Watermelon Ice Lolly
models.description: The smiling watermelon ice lolly from LEGO Classic 11039: 23 pieces, with three black seeds, a lime rind and a tan stick.

models.name: Xenomorph
models.description: A black alien in 49 pieces, 11 cm from its claws to the tip of its tail and 7 cm tall: a long domed head with silver teeth, tubes on its back and a jointed tail with spines and a barb. Every joint moves, and it stands on its two feet and the barb. Designed by yodakya.
